about: Playgrounds mapped on OpenStreetMap that an official source says aren't open to the public, so the jobs that add Unverified playgrounds from OpenStreetMap (scripts/find-gaps.mjs, scripts/junction-gaps.mjs) never add them again. Key: the OpenStreetMap id (way/123). Add one whenever a listing is removed for this reason, with a short note saying who told us.

playgrounds.way/1046353451: Off Pulleys Close, Aveton Gifford: on school land and private, says Aveton Gifford Parish Council (23 November 2026).
